description: Neton with the Kotlin/Native neton-http-netonstream adapter, using com.netonstream io/http/tls and OpenSSL. The same framework routes, middleware, request parsing and response pipeline as neton-hyper; only the engine differs. HTTP/1.1 on 8080, h2c on 8082, h1 TLS on 8081 and h2 TLS on 8443.
